newsitem.title: USA: GTE unit offers Tennessee local rate plan.
newsitem.headline: GTE unit offers Tennessee local rate plan.

text.p: Cellular One, owned and operated by GTE Corp, said on Wednesday it is offering a plan eliminating long distance charges to its customers calling from Tennessee to any state in the United States.
Customers may call from their home area, which is all of Tennessee except seven counties, and be billed at local airtime rates.
The company said the service is available to customers for $4.95 a month on top of monthly access charges.
